title: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-22
summary: First Guaranty Bancshares, Inc. filed a Form 8-K announcing the election of Ms. Betsy K. Hood to the Board of Directors on April 16, 2026. Ms. Hood is Dealer Principal of Hood Automotive Group and brings over 25 years of experience in the retail automotive industry. The filing contains no market structure or macro catalyst information.
